name: Brand Analyzer

It provides comprehensive frameworks for analyzing brand elements and creating actionable brand guidelines based on requirements.

name: Business Analytics Reporter
summary: This skill should be used when analyzing business sales and revenue data from CSV files to identify weak areas, generate statistical insights, and provide strategic improvement recommendations. Use when the user requests a business performance report, asks to analyze sales data, wants to identify areas of weakness, or needs recommendations on business improvement strategies.

name: Business Document Generator
summary: This skill should be used when the user requests to create professional business documents (proposals, business plans, or budgets) from templates. It provides PDF templates and a Python script for generating filled documents from user data.

name: Cicd Pipeline Generator

Use this for generating GitHub Actions workflows, GitLab CI configs, CircleCI configs, or other CI/CD platform configurations. Ideal for setting up automated pipelines for Node.js/Next.js applications, including linting, testing, building, and deploying to platforms like Vercel, Netlify, or AWS.

name: Codebase Documenter

The skill provides templates, best practices, and structured approaches for creating clear, beginner-friendly documentation.

name: Csv Data Visualizer

name: Data Analyst

Use this skill for tasks involving data quality assessment, automated missing value detection and filling, statistical analysis, and generating Plotly Dash dashboards for exploratory data analysis.

name: Docker Containerization
summary: This skill should be used when containerizing applications with Docker, creating Dockerfiles, docker-compose configurations, or deploying containers to various platforms. Ideal for Next.js, React, Node.js applications requiring containerization for development, production, or CI/CD pipelines. Use this skill when users need Docker configurations, multi-stage builds, container orchestration, or deployment to Kubernetes, ECS, Cloud Run, etc.

name: Docx

name: Finance Manager

Triggers include requests like "analyze my finances", "track my spending", "create a financial report", "extract transactions from PDF", "visualize my budget", "where is my money going", "financial insights", "spending breakdown", or any finance-related analysis tasks.

name: Pdf
